text: {"label":"Obsessive-Compulsive and Related Disorder Treatment","definition":"Assessment, conceptualization, and treatment of obsessive-compulsive behavior, including in autism, through exposure and response prevention, acceptance and commitment therapy, and psychological flexibility, plus related conditions such as misophonia and tics.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centres on obsessive-compulsive and related clinical conditions rather than panic and general anxiety treatment, laboratory studies of operant avoidance, or basic research on response organization and contrast."}
